HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Amendment No. 9 dated November 13, 2023 ✓
- Borrower: Audacy Capital Corp. (formerly Entercom Media Corp.) ✓
- Administrative Agent: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. ✓
- Original Credit Agreement date: October 17, 2016 ✓
- Interest payment grace period changed from 11 to 14 business days ✓
- Missed interest payments on October 31, 2023 and November 8, 2023 ✓
- New liens on insurance proceeds up to $5,000,000 ✓
- All subsidiary guarantor names listed ✓

The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for terms not disclosed in the amendment (deal size, interest rate, maturity date, etc.) rather than making unsupported claims. All factual assertions about financial terms are directly supported by the source document.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all key financial terms that are actually disclosed in the source document. While the memo shows "N/A" for several financial terms (deal size, interest rate, maturity date, etc.), this accurately reflects that these terms are not specified in Amendment No. 9 itself - this amendment only modifies specific provisions of the existing Credit Agreement without restating the underlying financial terms. The memo correctly identifies and includes the material terms that are disclosed:

- Amendment date (November 13, 2023)
- Key parties (Audacy Capital Corp., JPMorgan Chase Bank N.A.)
- The specific covenant modification (grace period extension from 11 to 14 business days)
- The new lien provision (insurance proceeds up to $5,000,000)
- The missed payment dates and amounts that triggered the amendment
- Original Credit Agreement date (October 17, 2016)

The memo appropriately notes the limitation that it's based solely on the amendment document and acknowledges that additional due diligence would be needed for complete financial analysis.
